content: As of my last update, Dell does not sell servers specifically with A40 GPUs. The A40 is an NVIDIA data center GPU primarily used for AI and graphics workloads. Dell does offer servers compatible with various NVIDIA GPUs, but you would need to check their current product lineup or contact Dell directly for the most up-to-date information on GPU availability in their server configurations.
